_comment: Written by the trading runs (9:30a / hourly / 3:30p ET). Never contains account numbers, broker IDs, or any account other than the sandbox.

account.note: RE-PULLED LIVE AT 15:22 ET BY THE LAST HOURLY OF THE DAY AND NOT CARRIED FORWARD: 1009.16 total, 1009.16 cash, zero equity value, zero options value, zero pending deposits and ZERO unsettled, unchanged from the 09:43, 10:22, 11:22 and 14:22 reads because nothing has traded. The book is FLAT - equity and option position lists were both queried live at 15:22 and both are empty - so no exit level of any kind is due this hour and this slot's whole job is answered by an empty book rather than skipped over it. ZERO equity orders and ZERO option orders exist for the entire session, so today's 33.86 AS specification was NEVER EXECUTED and expired unfilled at 10:30 on its own written terms; its 338.60 is unspent and the full balance is settled. NO SPECIFICATION IS LIVE, so the hourly re-validation duty is discharged by finding nothing open: none was confirmed, none was killed, none is in its last hour. The 15:30 window that today's rule change created closes with nothing standing in it. Fired 15:21 against the 15:17 slot, four minutes late, inside the 20-minute guard. The scope preflight matched the mandate identifier EXACTLY against the connector list; every other account was discarded unread. The clock was cross-checked against the broker rather than trusted: venue_bid_time reads 19:22:50.310 UTC against a local 15:21 ET, confirming the -4 EDT offset the guard was measured with.

entryWatch.setup: AS post-earnings day-1 continuation - the 100% EPS beat specified at a 33.86 limit this morning, expired unfilled at 10:30, and now trading below the session low its own entry named in advance as the early warning
entryWatch.trigger: DEAD, AND THE THESIS BEHIND IT IS NOW ON ITS OWN WRITTEN WARNING. AS is 33.01 bid / 33.03 ask at 19:22:50.310Z on a 0.06% spread, last trade 33.020, +1.35% on the bid against the 32.57 close. THE 09:49 ENTRY WROTE TWO INVALIDATION LEVELS BEFORE THE OUTCOME AND THE EARLIER ONE HAS TRIGGERED: it named failure to hold above the 33.41 session low as the early warning, and AS is trading 33.02. The later one - a close back below the 32.57 pre-print close, which voids the thesis outright - has NOT triggered, and the name is still green on the day. THE AFTERNOON RECOVERY IS FULLY REVERSED. The six-read bid series is 33.81 at 09:48, 33.90 at 10:22, 33.29 at 11:22, 33.24 at 13:21, 33.49 at 14:22 and 33.01 now: down 0.48 or 1.43% in the hour and the lowest of the six. The 33.03 ask is 0.83 BELOW the dead limit, the widest that gap has been all day against 0.35 an hour ago, so the fourth geometry the level was tested in today is simply the second one reopening wider. IT IS NOT REVIVED - not raised when the tape ran six cents through it at 10:22, not re-struck cheaper when the tape sat 0.57 and 0.62 beneath it at 11:22 and 13:21, not revived when the tape closed back toward it from below at 14:22, and not revived now. A specification that expired by its own written terms is not restored by the tape approaching it from any side, which is the principle that has refused SMCI on ten tests and UPST on one. THE COST OF THE 10:21 REFUSAL MOVED BACK IN ITS FAVOUR AND IS LOGGED AT THE SAME WEIGHT AS THE HOUR IT MOVED AGAINST IT: ten shares at 33.86 for 338.60 would read 330.10, -8.50 or -2.51%, against -1.09% at 14:22 and -1.68% at 11:22 - the worst print of the series; raised to 33.92 it would be -2.68%. One session's tape paying a refusal is not evidence about refusals in general, and the six prints where not filling COST money still stand beside it. Any re-entry is tomorrow's decision on tomorrow's quotes: the day-2 pullback this rulebook actually prefers cannot exist before then, and the pre-close slot may not open a position in the last thirty minutes.
entryWatch.why: THE FOURTH CONSECUTIVE SPECIFICATION TO EXPIRE UNEXECUTED, AND THE COUNT IS THE FINDING RATHER THAN THIS ONE ORDER. JOBY at 8.85, SMCI at 38.24 twice, now AS at 33.86: four published theses, none executed, agentTrades still 0. A process whose output nobody executes is not being tested, however good the reasoning reads. What this entry got RIGHT is worth separating from what happened to it: item 1 passed on a dated event for the first time in five sessions, the field was widened to names printing that morning rather than the bar lowered, the option was refused on a spread that doubled in four minutes, and the limit was struck AT the ask precisely to avoid the three prior expiries. It still expired - not because the limit was too low, but because it was never marketable to a human who was not there at 10:30. THE DAY-1 TIMING THE OPEN FLAGGED AGAINST ITSELF IS THE PART THE TAPE ARGUED WITH. The open wrote that a grader should mark the day-1 entry even though no checklist item failed it, because the rulebook prefers the day-2/3 pullback. Six cents of unfilled limit later, AS has given back more than half its move and the preferred setup - a level struck AFTER the fade, on lighter volume, with a written invalidation - is the one that cannot exist until tomorrow. That is the rulebook's own reasoning arriving on schedule, and it is the reason this is not re-entered now.

entryWatch.setup: SMCI post-print pullback - the twice-forced thesis this board specified yesterday and did not fill, now dropping through the level it was struck at
entryWatch.trigger: DEAD ON A TENTH TEST AND MARKETABLE AGAIN, WHICH CHANGES NOTHING. SMCI is 37.47 bid / 37.48 ask at 19:22:51.411Z, a 0.03% spread and again the tightest quote on the board, -2.12% against the 38.28 close and up 0.17 on the bid from the 37.30 read at 14:22. The 37.48 ask is 0.76 BELOW the 38.24 limit that expired unfilled on 8/17 - that order would still fill three quarters of a dollar better than it asked. It is not revived. A specification that expired by its own terms is not restored by the tape reaching it, generously or otherwise; its thesis was FORCED on items 1 and 5, the 8/11 print is six sessions back, and SMCI does not appear anywhere in the live 8/18-to-8/26 earnings calendar. Had seven shares filled at 38.24 for 267.68 they would read 262.29 now, -5.39 or -2.01% - the tenth print in a series that has run from -0.1% to -4.76% and has never once been green.
entryWatch.why: NOT REVIVED, AND THE REASON IS UNCHANGED RATHER THAN NEWLY CONVENIENT. Yesterday's entry was forced on items 1 and 5: no catalyst, with the 8/11 print then four sessions back and now five, and its own written buy condition unmet. Neither has been repaired by the price falling - a cheaper entry into a thesis with no catalyst is a cheaper entry into a thesis with no catalyst. SMCI appears nowhere in the live 8/18-to-8/26 calendar. It keeps its place on the board only for liquidity, which remains the best here at a 0.05% spread on 24.4B, and it is passed over today for a name whose item 1 passes outright.

entryWatch.setup: KLAR post-print collapse - a beat that lost a fifth of the company, held here as a watch item and explicitly NOT bought
entryWatch.trigger: STILL MAKING SESSION LOWS SIX HOURS AFTER THE PRINT, AND STILL NOT A SETUP. KLAR is 15.12 bid / 15.13 ask at 19:22:46.864Z, -22.50% against the 19.51 close, below the 15.21 read at 14:22 and below the 15.75 the open read. The gap has not begun to base, and a base is the precondition any entry here would need - the first print of a 22% gap is not a support level and no setup in this rulebook covers it. It is kept on the board as the live counterexample that stops item 1 decaying into 'a number came out': two EPS beats printed this morning, and one is +1.4% while the other is -22.5%.
entryWatch.why: IT IS ON THE BOARD BECAUSE IT IS THE CLEANEST LIVE COUNTEREXAMPLE TO TODAY'S OWN THESIS AND SHOULD BE VISIBLE NEXT TO IT. AS and KLAR both beat this morning; AS is +3.8% and KLAR is -19.3%. An EPS beat is not a catalyst on its own, and holding the two side by side is what stops item 1 from decaying into 'a number came out'. What would make KLAR a setup rather than a falling knife: a day-2 or day-3 base that holds a level struck AFTER the gap, on lighter volume, with a written invalidation - none of which can exist before tomorrow.

candidatesNote: All twelve rows are bids from ONE quote call at 13:48:32 UTC, so the board reads on a single timestamp rather than blending reads taken minutes apart. AS was added today and the eleven others carried forward. ELEVEN OF TWELVE ARE RED and AS is the only green name, which is the tape this entry is being made into.

candidates.note: 33.81 bid, +3.81% against the 32.57 close, and THE NAME SPECIFIED TODAY at a 33.86 limit for 10 shares - the first NOT-forced entry in this board's recent record. Reported this morning at 0.22 EPS against a 0.11 estimate, a 100% beat, verified on the live calendar and hours old, which is item 1 passing on a dated event rather than on a valuation number standing in for one. Liquidity is real: 19.44B market cap, 4.85M thirty-day average, 2.33M shares already done, and a 0.148% spread. Positioning into the print was de-risked rather than crowded - five red sessions and -10.0% from 36.17 on 8/10 to a 32.08 low yesterday - which is why item 5 passes. Session: opened 33.84, high 34.6974, low 33.41, dip bought. THE ONLY GREEN NAME OF TWELVE, and green on its own news rather than on the tape. What is NOT claimed: this is a day-1 entry and the rulebook prefers the day-2/3 pullback, so the timing is the weakest part of it. Its 9/18 32.5 call cleared every option gate at 13:43:58Z on a 6.45% spread and had blown out to 20.0% by 13:47:29Z, which is why the instrument is equity.

37.35 bid, -2.43%, and 0.89 BELOW the 38.24 limit that expired unfilled yesterday. The twice-forced thesis is not revived: a cheaper price does not supply the catalyst item 1 wanted, the 8/11 print is now five sessions back, and SMCI is absent from the live 8/18-8/26 calendar. Not filling has cost this board money on six prints and saved it 6.23 on the seventh, which is recorded with the same weight. Best liquidity on the board at a 0.05% spread on 24.4B.

15.75 bid, -19.27%, on an EPS BEAT of 0.01 against -0.06. Not bought. The first print of a 19% gap is not a support level, and no setup in the rulebook covers it. Kept on the board as the live counterexample to today's AS thesis: two beats this morning, one +3.8% and one -19.3%, which is what stops item 1 from decaying into 'a number came out'.

95.10 bid, -8.66%, on an EPS MISS of 1.06 against a 1.35 estimate. A dated catalyst that resolved against the name. Not a candidate - buying the down half of a print is not one of this board's setups, and item 2's instruction to prefer the pullback after strength has no application to a name with no strength.

29.19 bid, -1.88%, and now a full point beneath the 30.20/30.32 shelf whose loss this board wrote as the invalidation in advance. Ten sessions past its print with nothing dated ahead. The expired 30.59 limit stays dead and is 4.8% above the bid.
45.17 bid, -3.57%. Nine sessions past its print with nothing dated ahead and no second argument in the catalyst's place. Item 1 refuses it.
18.13 bid, -2.89%. Eight sessions past its print, nothing dated ahead, and part of the quantum complex that unwound together on 8/17 - the correlation the 2026-08-10 rule was written about.
7.01 bid, -0.43%, the flattest name on the board and the closest thing to green after AS. Eight sessions past its print with nothing dated ahead. Item 1 refuses it on the same ground as the rest.
41.81 bid, -4.72%, the weakest of the nuclear names and the second weakest on the board. Nothing dated ahead. Named in the 8/10 rule as one of the four that led hardest and unwound hardest.
8.93 bid, -2.83%. Nothing dated ahead, and the name this account closed at -14.0% on 8/6. Same complex as OKLO, so two of them would be the concentration limit rather than diversification.

7.67 bid, -3.03%. Eight sessions past its print with nothing dated ahead. The 8.85 limit from the 8/10 forced entry expired unfilled and is 15.4% above the bid - dead, and not re-struck cheaper for the same reason SMCI is not.

485.87 bid, -3.98%. One share is 48.2% of the account against the 40% single-name ceiling, so it is refused by an explicit mechanical limit before any view is formed. The ratio improved only because AMD fell.
